name: Movenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc
short_description: A 305-room resort on Ong Lang Beach with private balconies or pool access, a 720sqm column-free ballroom, a 15-treatment-room spa, and a Little Birds kids' club.
ai_summary: Movenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc is set on Ong Lang Beach on the island's west coast, roughly 30-40 minutes from the airport and 15-20 minutes from Duong Dong town. The 305 rooms feature private balconies or pool access, and the resort's 720sqm column-free ballroom is the largest single event space on Ong Lang Beach, alongside a wellness spa with 15 treatment rooms, private beach access, and the Little Birds Club for daily kids' activities. Guests consistently praise the spacious, modern rooms with ocean views, attentive staff, and villa accommodations, though a subset note beach litter and limited vegetarian options.

faqs.question: Where is Movenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc located?
faqs.answer: On Ong Lang Beach, on the west coast of Phu Quoc island, about 30-40 minutes from the airport and 15-20 minutes from Duong Dong town.

faqs.question: Does Movenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc have villas?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside 305 rooms with private balconies or pool access, the adjoining Movenpick Villas & Residences Phu Quoc offers private-pool villas and residences within the same complex.
